title: Q3
description:
Read: 2Sa 7:11-13, Zec 6:12-13

A son of David will build a house for the name. The Branch builds the temple, is a priest on his throne, and the counsel of peace is between the two offices.

a) The Son is called the builder, and the people are the house if they hold fast. What is the house in these two promises, and where do they differ?
